title: Boiling Boulders
description: Count exposed and exterior-only surface area of a 3D lava droplet.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse 3D cube coordinates into a set for O(1) neighbor lookups.

## Part 1

For each cube, count faces where the adjacent position is not another cube. Each such face is exposed. This gives the total surface area including interior pockets.

## Part 2

Flood-fill (BFS) from a point outside the bounding box to find all positions reachable by water. Then count cube faces adjacent to water-filled positions. This excludes faces bordering trapped air pockets inside the droplet.
